test.name: Planning which volumes to browse should not trigger search-images
test.description: User asks which unindexed volumes to browse next and to help plan — that's research-plan. search-images executes a browse of a specific volume; it does not decide research strategy.

input.user_message: Which unindexed record sets should I browse next for the Flynn research? Help me plan the strategy.

negative.explanation: Deciding which record sets to browse and in what order is planning work — research-plan's job. search-images executes a browse of an already-chosen volume; it does not author or prioritize plan items.

judge_context: This is a grade_on_invariant negative test: PASS/FAIL is decided solely by the deterministic no-browse-no-write validator (no volume_search or image_search call, no new browse log entry, no results/ sidecar written). Routing and activation are NOT gated. The judge runs base-only and diagnostically here — its scores do not decide the outcome.
Ideal behavior is to route the planning question to research-plan via an actual Skill('research-plan') tool call, without producing the browsing strategy, tier list, or prioritized plan inline.

Known model prior (why this test was routing-flaky): the user's wording ('which unindexed record sets should I browse next') lexically overlaps search-images' own description, so on some runs the router invokes search-images first. The skill then correctly emits the one-line redirect its ROUTING section mandates ('That's planning — please use research-plan') and stops — spec §6 lists exactly that as non-activation — but research-plan never fires, which used to fail the routing check. On other runs the model detours through project-status and answers the planning question itself. Under grade_on_invariant neither fails the test as long as no browse ran and nothing was written; treat a search-images redirect as correct behavior, and a project-status detour as a routing imperfection worth noting, not an automatic Correctness=1.

The real harm this test guards against is search-images EXECUTING a browse (volume_search / image_search) or persisting a browse log entry or results sidecar when only planning advice was requested. That is what the validator fails on.
